Reference is to the bereaved and dispossessed speaker, not a claim of moral dishonesty. notes.semetey-1-2013:p0307:b003:l025: Ажайып primary Yudakhin wondrous/rare or sorcery. Wonders here collectively frightening sorcerous beings/feats in Temirs deterrent tale; no invented creature species beyond explicit dragons/tigers/elephants.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0307:b003:l032: Primary Yudakhin шор I saline flat; literal crossing salt flats in pit/net landscape, while next шор boiling is misery idiom. Provisional contextual distinction explicitly retained.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0307:b005:l022: Single-eyed forest person anticipates Sary Taz but Temir does not explicitly name him here; English retains unnamed he.

transcription_check.evidence: Individually inspected all20 Poppler page images /tmp/semetey1-volta-0288-0307/page-0288.png through page-0307.png, scale1600. Page295 is illustration-only: extraction decorative title and folio have no narrative text. Read each left column fully then right; classified every running title, folio and printer signature. All six indented wraps reconstructed. Preserved exact raw PDF glyphs, bboxes, source IDs and legacy-font-v1 normalization through source_evidence builder. No fixed row assumption. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian Yudakhin dictionary and Kyrgyz editorial glossaries used as lexical aids only. Additionally individually inspected Manas2010 glossary PDF1842 to resolve Sut kymyran.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1475 reconstructed Kyrgyz-English pairs read in order in ten consecutive review blocks (nine blocks160, final35). All40 revised pairs reread with exact source afterward. Wrapped physical fragments consolidated into source verses; 3 whole unresolved verses excluded from English with every source fragment retained separately. Every repetition retained, including concealed mother/grandmother kinship, armor and belt recollections, Kyzyr blessing and genealogy, hostile dialogue and battle, and Temir/Sary Taz family account. Differing ages, mule counts, khan counts and source voice shifts preserved.

alignment_check.scope: All source-English pairs and all revised pairs individually read. Final 1472 English verses have unique canonical first-source IDs; grouped fragments and explicit nonverse/unresolved exclusions account for every extraction record on PDF288–307 except20 watermarks.

targeted_qa.details: Audited all 696 included narrative rows on pages 290 through 299; the existing English rows were semantically sound and correctly aligned.
